title: Render Dispatch door slots from the resolver dispatch prepare uses
judge_obligation_ack: Fix cell from an independent bee-review read (P1: block rendered raw config, not prepare's resolution); the same reviewer re-reads at cap.
action: Review finding P1/P2 on commit 37f3cc38: `tier_slot_display` in hooks/model_guard.rs parses raw config with the hook's own parser and applies no defaults, so with no `models` key it prints `session default` for every slot while `dispatch prepare` resolves sonnet/haiku/opus (see verbs/drivers/tests.rs:285-294), and it falls review back to generation whenever review is absent in config, while drivers::resolve_tier only falls back on an explicit `review: null`. FIX: rewrite `pub(crate) fn tier_slot_display(models_raw: Option<&Value>, runtime: &str) -> Vec<(&'static str, String)>` to build the map with `crate::verbs::drivers::models::normalize_models(models_raw)` and resolve each of generation/extraction/review with `crate::verbs::drivers::models::resolve_tier(&map, slot, runtime, kind)` (kind "reviewer" for review, "gather" for generation/extraction) and advisor with `resolve_advisor(&map, runtime)`. Render that Resolved: Model{model,effort} -> model (append `:<effort>` when Some); Herding{agent,fallback} -> `herding (<agent>)` or `herding`, plus ` fallback=<fallback>` when fallback is Some; Cli{..} -> `cli`; Native{model,..} -> `native:<model>`; Inherit -> `session default`; Budget -> `session default`; Refused{..} -> `cli`; advisor None -> `none`. Delete the now-unused `parse_runtime_slots` and `format_slot_display`, and restore `normalize_models` to its pre-37f3cc38 borrowing loop (no `raw.clone()` per runtime; `git show 37f3cc38^:packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/hooks/model_guard.rs` has the original) — the guard's own refusal logic must not change. Update the tests in session_preamble/tests.rs and compaction.rs to the true strings: no models key -> `generation=sonnet | extraction=haiku | review=opus | advisor=none`; herding on generation only -> `generation=herding (agy-flash) | extraction=haiku | review=opus | advisor=none`; keep the all-four-configured test. Add one assertion that the rendered generation string for `{"claude":{"generation":{"kind":"herding","agent":"agy-flash"}}}` matches what drivers resolve_tier returns for that map (same-source proof). Run the three test filters model_guard, session_preamble, compaction (separately) plus the drivers tests. Commit once; the commit body's LAST line must be exactly `cell: ddu-3`; then cap the cell with the finish verb as the contract says — do not skip it.

truths: tier_slot_display reads the same normalize_models/resolve_tier the dispatch prepare door reads
Guard refusal logic unchanged in behavior; normalize_models no longer clones per runtime
